edits.headline: Grass fire kills four soldiers at Canadian military base in Alberta
edits.subheadline: The fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright also critically injured 19 other people, the Associated Press reported.
editorialBody: Four Canadian soldiers were killed when a grass fire overtook troops at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta, Al Jazeera reported. The fire critically injured 19 other people, and Canada sent 50 investigators to examine it, the Associated Press reported.
In France, mass protests over rising prices turned into the worst riots in years, the Honolulu Star-Advertiser reported. The Kuwait Times reported looting, fires and clashes during the protests.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio began a visit to India with a trade deal and India's purchases of Russian oil on the agenda, Khaleej Times reported.
Miley Cyrus paid an emotional tribute to Dolly Parton at the Hollywood Bowl, ABC7 reported.
